title: MASPRM: Multi-Agent System Process Reward Model
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a Multi-Agent System Process Reward Model (MASPRM) to improve reasoning and search efficiency in multi-agent systems. Its evaluation is centered on mathematical, logical, and general knowledge benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, LOGIQA) without any specific focus on religious, moral, or ethical benchmarking.
